scope: Source/provenance and curve-summary metadata only. Full normalized curves and targets remain private.

sources.citation: Wang et al. Superconducting 2D NbS2 Grown Epitaxially by Chemical Vapor Deposition. ACS Nano 15,18403–18410 (2021).
notes: CSV data license differs from the paper's CC-BY-NC-ND license.
Nominal NbS2; sulfur defects are reported, no exact per-device stoichiometry inferred.

sources.citation: Sidorova et al. Quantum light detection in high-temperature superconducting nanowires. npj Nanophotonics 2,38 (2025).
notes: Device includes a 100 nm-wide nanowire and series 1 micrometre-wide inductor; total device resistance is not material resistivity.
Two segments of one device, not two materials; preserve overlap without counting as independent specimens.

sources.citation: Charaev et al. Single-photon detection using large-scale high-temperature MgB2 sensors at 20 K. Nature Communications 15 (2024).
notes: Raw Fig.1b workbook headers R,T contradict plotted axis/ranges; quarantine until column interpretation is explicitly accepted.

sources.citation: Dong et al. Establishing an end-to-end workflow for SNSPD fabrication and characterization. Scientific Reports 14,30891 (2024).
notes: Original XLSX repository MD5 verified. Ingested TSV is an additional repository transformation.
Measurement pressure/field unreported; deposition 2.5 mTorr is not measurement pressure.

sources.citation: Sasaki et al. Enhancement of superconductivity in thin films of Sn under high pressure. Physical Review B 111,104513 (2025).
notes: Resistance rather than resistivity; compression/decompression and pressure medium remain distinct conditions.
Possible 11 K anomaly discussed separately; not promoted to a confirmed Tc.

sources.citation: Leung et al. Evidence for isotropic s-wave superconductivity in high-entropy alloys. Scientific Reports 12,12773 (2022).
notes: Two measured alloy groups x=.35/.71, nominal file names .4/.75; not many independent materials.
ZFC/FC are low-T magnetization, no broad-T normal resistance curves in this package.

sources.citation: Moulding et al. Absence of superconducting dome at the charge-density-wave quantum phase transition in 2H-NbSe2. Physical Review Research 2,043392 (2020).
sources.dataset_license: Non-Commercial Government Licence for public sector information (repository landing); not paper's CC-BY
notes: Deposited Hall/volume susceptibility and extracted transitions; no original longitudinal rho(T) curve in deposit.
Sample numbering differs between deposited README and paper figure captions. No strict cross-quantity sample join is certified.
